source: Starloco Dofus SQL monster table; local fallback aggregation for Wakemu

policy.meaning: Derived emulator fallback, not an official or universal per-level reward formula.
policy.input_rows: Final monsters table after seed and ordered db-init update_game files.
policy.include: monster_type=1; not boss or archmonster; name does not contain 'invoc'; grade XP > 0; grade level 1..200.
policy.aggregation: floor(integer median) independently for base XP, min kamas and max kamas among eligible monster-grade rows at each source level.
policy.holes: For an unobserved level, carry the nearest lower observed level; expose source_level so this is auditable.
policy.wakemu_mapping: No Dofus monster IDs are mapped to Wakfu references. Apply these values only as a level fallback, overridden by explicit Wakemu reference+level policy rows.
